paragraphs.text: The Space Family Goblinson is a legendary family of Goblin Guests who visit the Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .
The goblin word for “vacation” translates roughly to “a battered landscape of noise and violence.

The Space Family Goblinson is a goblin family comprised of a father, mother, and four children. They are all goblins with green, cracked skin and large ears. The father has a mohawk of brown hair, while the mother has black hair. Two of the children have mohawks like their father, while the other two are hairless. They often bicker, but they are a tight-knit family with an extremely wholesome and positive home life.
The Space Family Goblinson are named after The Swiss Family Robinson , a novel about a shipwrecked family.
